goals.objective: Deeply ambitiously improve prior_cognitive_art across formal methods, deterministic illustrative simulations, documentation, visualizations, and manuscript writing. Use omo:ulw-loop and superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents. Respect the project contract unless deliberately changing scope: any simulations must be deterministic, conceptual/illustrative, and must not introduce empirical performance claims. Regenerate source-owned artifacts, rendered PDF, and web/dashboard surfaces. Verify through tests, publication validator, PDF render, and browser/dashboard manual QA.
